node.statement: Since 0<=L^0*epsilon<=W.L*epsilon=epsilon_R, the defining inequalities in def-epsilon-cstar-algebra only weaken when the defect parameter is enlarged, at every matrix level in def-extended-epsilon-cstar-algebra. Hence A_R is an extended epsilon_R-C*-algebra. Also every direct-envelope error is <=L^0*epsilon<=W.L*epsilon=epsilon_R<=t_3, so the target ambient record and every other envelope-produced datum error are dominated by t_3.
